title: First chat list cards
summary: A new account's Conversas is never empty (bipe-chat/bipe#198): cards to invite someone, share your @ and QR, and open Anotações, at the top of the list while it has few chats. Grupos without groups offers to create one.

cards.description: The cards that show, in registry order: Conversas lists at most firstList.maxChats chats, the card was neither used nor dismissed on this account, and a card with when hasHandle shows only while the account has an @.

handle.description: The account's @ without the @, for bipe_first_card_profile_body.

shareInvite.effect: Makes a personal invite (BipeInviteCreator.createIfAvailable on iOS; myInvites and createInvite on Android) and opens the system share sheet with its link. No invites left: opens the invites screen, which says why. Marks the card used.

shareProfile.effect: Opens the system share sheet with bipe.chat/@handle (BipeProfileLink.url). Marks the card used.

profileQr.effect: Opens the profile QR (profile-link, QR shown). Marks the card used.

notes.effect: Opens Anotações (voce openNotes). Marks the card used.

dismiss.effect: Hides the card for good on this account.

createGroup.effect: Grupos with no groups: opens group-create.

notes: Titles, bodies, buttons, the order and maxChats come from the generated onboarding code (BipeOnboardingCard, BipeOnboarding.firstListMaxChats); the apps never hard-code them.
The inviter's chat comes first on its own: signup-done opens it, and it is the first row of Conversas. Its one-tap first message is the inviter hint (signup-done notes, bipe_inviter_hint_action).
Without an @ the profile card does not show; the handle prompt (registries/onboarding.json prompts.handle, trigger chatListWithoutHandle) asks for one above the list instead.
Anotações stays in Você (voce openNotes, ADR 0112): the notes card opens it from the chat list and is not a pinned chat row.
Used and dismissed cards are kept per account on this phone and never come back.
Grupos: "Entre com um link" waits for joining a group by link, which Bipe Next does not have yet.
